question: Two trains 124 m and 116 m long are moving towards each other with speeds of 28 km/h and 44 km/h respectively. How much time will they take to cross each other after meeting?
solution:
Given:

Lengths of two trains = 124 m and 116 m

Speeds of two trains = 28 km/h and 44 km/h

Formulas used:

Relative speed (Opposite direction) = Speed1 + Speed2 

Time = Distance/Relative Speed 

Calculation:

Distance to be covered by two trains = Length of two trains 

⇒ 124 m + 116 m = 240 m 

Time = 240 m/(28 + 44) km/h 

⇒ 240/ 72 × 5/18 

⇒ 240/72 × 18/5 [1 hour = 3600 seconds, 1 km = 1000 m] 

⇒ 12 

∴ The required time taken by the trains is 12 seconds.
